premises.text: Childhood obesity is a significant concern for parents in the United States.
premises.evidence_span: Childhood obesity is the number one concern for parents in the United States today.

premises.text: Existing weight loss options for adults are not safe for children.
premises.evidence_span: none of it is safe for kids.

premises.text: The Stanford Pediatric Obesity Center has a high success rate for weight loss.
premises.evidence_span: At Stanford, 85% of the kids lose weight, 70% of the parents lose weight.

premises.text: A mobile platform can help children eat healthier and lose weight.
premises.evidence_span: Curbo is a mobile platform to enable children to eat healthier and to lose weight.

premises.text: Tracking food by nutritional value rather than calories is effective for children.
premises.evidence_span: we have you track your red, yellow, and green foods.

premises.text: Personalized feedback from a coach can help children make healthier choices.
premises.evidence_span: a coach calls... and gives them very specific feedback on how to budget for a birthday party, and how to eat healthier.

premises.text: The business model includes free food tracking to attract users.
premises.evidence_span: We're giving a free food tracker so that we can attract as many kids as we can.

premises.text: Kerbo can scale through partnerships with health insurers and educational institutions.

value.text: Kerbo helps millions of kids worldwide eat healthier, feel great, and lose weight.
value.evidence_span: At Kerbo, our job is to help millions of kids worldwide eat healthier, feel great, and lose weight.

notes: Traction metrics and personal anecdotes excluded as they do not support premises.
